instagram.caption:
The tool that lives out.
The Vanity Counter in the Primary Bathroom. To hold the handful of things you touch every morning and every night, and nothing else.

What done looks like:
1. One tray you can lift with one hand
2. The toothbrush holder
3. No more than four daily products. Bare stone on both sides of the basin
4. A mirror with no splatter

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success vanity counter.
